hero_desc: A community-first boxing gym in the heart of Islington. Keeping youth off the streets, building discipline, and training champions for the ring.
mission_body: As a registered Community Interest Company (CIC), Hercules Boxing Club exists to serve the Islington community. We are actively working towards our official England Boxing affiliation to elevate our athletes to the national stage.
p1_desc: We ensure that cost is never a barrier. Our session fees are heavily subsidized to protect and empower disadvantaged local youth.
p2_desc: Preparing to step onto the national stage. Our upcoming affiliation allows our boxers to officially compete in tournaments.
p3_desc: Committed to excellence in welfare. We adhere strictly to national safeguarding policies to protect all our members.
